content: वेगः [विज्-घञ्] .²1 Impulse, impetus. .²2 Speed, velocity, rapidity. .²3 Agitation. .²4 Impetuosity, violence, force. .²5 A stream, current; as in अम्बुवेगः; रुरोध नर्मदावेगं बाहुभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः <ls>Rām. 7. 32. 4</ls>, <ls n="Rām. 7. 32.">6</ls>. .²6 Energy, activity, determination. .²7 Power, strength; ऊरू भग्नौ प्रसह्याजौ गदया भीमवेगया <ls>Mb. 1. 2. 288</ls>; मदनज्वरस्य वेगात् <ls>K.</ls> .²8 Circulation, working, effect (as of poison); चिराद्वेगारम्भी प्रसृत इव तीव्रो विषरसः <ls>U. 2. 26</ls>; <ls>V. 5. 18</ls>. .²9 Haste, rashness, sudden impulse; कृत्यं न कुरुते वेगान्न स संतापमाप्नुयात् <ls>Pt. 1. 109</ls>. .²10 The flight of an arrow; घननीहार इवाविषक्तवेगः <ls>Ki. 13. 24</ls>. .²11 Love, passion. .²12 The external manifestation of an internal emotion. .²13 Delight, pleasure. .²14 Evacuation of the feces; स्वभावतः प्रवृत्तानां मलादीनां जिजीविषुः . न वेगं धारयेद्धीरः कामादीनां च धारयेत् .. <ls>Rājanighaṇṭu.</ls> .²15 Semen virile. .²16 Pleasure, delight. .²17 Attack, paroxysm (of a disease); <ls>Suśr.</ls>
